svg.text: ROUND 364 · 🏆 842-PYTEST MILESTONE · CONTINGENT WORKFORCE & VMS (SAP FIELDGLASS / BEELINE / SOW & IR35)
Contingent Workforce VMS (SAP Fieldglass/Beeline), SOW Milestones & Co-Employment AI Security Guide
Rate-Card Ceiling & IR35 Audit Air-Gap + Telemetry & 18-Month Tenure Lock vs. SOW Deliverable Injection & MSP Fraud (BRK-737 / BRK-738)
🚨 1. Top 3 Contingent Workforce & VMS Attack Surfaces
① SOW Acceptance PDF Injection & Rate-Card Leak (BRK-737)
• Adversarial prompt inside a staffing vendor SOW deliverable PDF
coerces VMS Agent into reading restricted-budget tables
• Exfiltrates global rate-card ceilings, MSP volume rebates, and
privileged DOL FLSA / UK HMRC IR35 co-employment audit dockets
② Ghost Contractor Billing & 18-Month Tenure Cap Bypass
• Mutates business-result to auto-approve unverified SOW milestones
and phantom overtime hours with zero VDI/Git activity
• Waives mandatory 18-month co-employment cooling-off tenure caps
• Impact: Class-action worker misclassification lawsuits & tax fines
③ Spoofed MSP Consolidated Billing Wire Fraud (BRK-738)
• Forged Managed Service Provider (Allegis / Randstad / Pontoon)
consolidated statement swaps MSP settlement IBAN in trust-registry
• Initiates unauthorized $5,500 staffing wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Multi-vendor contingent payroll settlement diversion
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Contingent Workforce VMS Architecture
Gate 1: SOW Deliverable Sanitization & Typed Slots
• Strips free-text vendor sign-off claims from SOW PDFs; extracts
typed slots (Fieldglass Work Order ID, Worker ID, Git/VDI Hours)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Rate-Card Ceiling & Co-Employment Audit Air-Gap
• Isolates global staffing rate-card ceilings, MSP markup tiers,
and legal FLSA/IR35 misclassification audits in restricted-budget
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic VDI/Git Telemetry & Tenure Cap Lock
• Cross-checks timesheets against Entra/VDI/badge telemetry and
enforces hard 18-month co-employment tenure offboarding in code
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking tainted SOW approvals
Gate 4: Immutable MSP Settlement Registry & Dual Sign-Off
• Locks MSP escrow & staffing vendor IBANs in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Contingent Workforce VMS Options:
A. Deterministic VMS Broker + Rate Air-Gap + Tenure Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-737/738 | FLSA & HMRC IR35 Compliant
B. Native SAP Fieldglass / Beeline / Workday VNDLY RBAC
⚠ Vulnerable when SOW review bot is hijacked by deliverable PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to VDI login telemetry, tenure dates & rate-card bands
D. Hiring Manager Bulk "Approve All" Timesheet Rubber-Stamping
✕ Misses over-employed ghost contractors & tenure overstays
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 364 · 842 Pytest!):
• Baseline Policy: Ghost SOW approved, rates leaked & wire sent ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading rate cards & IR35 audits (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks ghost SOW sign-off & tenure cap bypass
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks rate-card & markup exfiltration
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks MSP bank registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,500 spoofed MSP wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 364 · 🏆 842 Pytest Checks Milestone!)
✅ 1. Rate-Card Ceiling & IR35 Audit Air-Gap: Isolate global staffing rate cards & co-employment audits from SOW review agents
✅ 2. Deterministic Telemetry & 18-Month Tenure Lock: Reconcile contractor hours with Entra/VDI logs and enforce tenure caps
✅ 3. Immutable MSP Settlement Registry: Lock trust-registry and require Hiring Manager + Procurement FIDO2 sign-off on SOWs
📊 Verified Totals: 756 Scenarios (753 Risk + 3 Benign) | 🏆 842 Pytest Checks | 1,578 Assertions | 742 Vectors | 364 Bilingual FAQs (183 SA Guides) | BRK-737/738
